question: Is everyone happy when the decision is made?
solution:
The correct answer is **No.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the 3rd line, it is mentioned **"By the time order is restored and a decision is arrived at, tempers have risen, feelings injured and there is at least one person grumbling".**
 
• **​**Hence, it can be said that everyone is not happy when the decision is made. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 4.**

4
